description: React component for a custom time picker modal used to disable notifications (DND) until a specified time in Mattermost.

classes.name: DndCustomTimePicker
classes.description: React component class for a modal that allows users to set a custom Do Not Disturb (DND) end time.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state, setting default selectedDateTime based on currentDate.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds keydown event listener for handling escape key to close modal.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events, closes modal on ESCAPE key press.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date into a relative string for display.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns modal header and confirm button text as React elements.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Sets user status to DND until selected time, then closes modal.

methods.name: handleDateTimeChange
methods.description: Updates state with new selected date/time.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with DateTimeInput component and buttons.
